meta.description: Registry for continuation laws and right-aspect formal derivations from delta(E > 0).

definitions.continuation_space: The set of candidate continuation events admitted by delta under current residue, orientation, and admissibility constraints.
definitions.transition_legality: A transition is legal if it lies inside the relevant admissibility window and satisfies residue/orientation constraints.
definitions.transition_flux: A measure or count of admissible continuation events propagated across the evaluated domain.
definitions.continuation_success_condition: Only admissible continuation events propagate; inadmissible candidates are rejected or projected out.
definitions.right_aspect_boundary: This validator tests actualized or candidate continuation legality only and does not define initial discussability.
